title: El Tapir
description: The group's own working farm in Paraguay — open to visitors by appointment.
longDescription: El Tapir is the group's own farm, currently expanding. It's the one fully named reference behind Orbolo's wider network of partner ranches — come see the cattle and the land for yourself.

description: Education, site visits, and the non-profit work behind Orbolo's main business.
longDescription: Orbolo Bridge is the home for education and site visits for organisations, alongside the non-profit activities that support the group's main business. Small today, built to grow.

title: Remote Rancher
description: Own cattle on a working Paraguayan ranch — released for deployment at 60% committed.
longDescription: Remote Rancher lets you own cattle on a working ranch in Paraguay. Our Paraguayan operating company buys, tags, raises and sells them under the Orbolo Code, and pays you when the cycle closes. No capital is called before a ranch is released at 60% committed.

title: Ganadería a Pasto
description: Pasture-based cattle ranching — how Orbolo grows its supply across Paraguay.
longDescription: Ganadería a Pasto is the technical arm behind Orbolo's supply: pasture-based cattle ranching practiced across Paraguay's predominantly flat, open land.

title: Beef
description: Grass-fed Paraguayan beef, sold at conventional market prices today.
longDescription: Today Orbolo sources grass-fed beef from the Paraguayan market under the MPCS standard and sells it at conventional market prices. A traceable, aligned supply is being built from a large producer alliance — trade with us now and get first pick as it comes online.
